subject: Weaver's clothes
text: The weaver will not finish weaving until the player saves and restarts the game.

evidence.quote: You can keep bugging him all day, but until you save and restart he'll never...finish.

subject: Weaver's clothes
text: Lacking a Dragon's Potion is a problem because no people to save are nearby.

evidence.quote: Pain in the ass if you don't have a Dragon's Potion as there are no...people to save with nearby.

subject: Experience points
text: Experience points stop counting at 1,000,000 for each character.

evidence.quote: The game stops counting at 1,000,000 exp for each character.

subject: Enemy HP
text: Enemy HP is slightly random; a Baboon may have 45 HP instead of 40.

evidence.quote: Enemy HPs are slightly random, so if the number is close, it may in fact be a...weird Baboon with 45 hp for example, instead of 40.

subject: Repel
text: Repel depends on current HP rather than max HP, so heal fully before using it.

evidence.quote: Also, make sure you are...fully healed before repeling away, it seems to go by current HP, not max.

subject: Mink Coat
object: Staff of Thunder or Sword of Destruction
text: If you cannot afford a Mink Coat, selling a Staff of Thunder or Sword of Destruction gives decent money.

evidence.quote: If you want to be able to buy it, sell things like staff of thunders or swords...of destruction.  They fetch decent prices.

subject: Mink Coat
text: If you do not want to buy a Mink Coat, equip the Armor of Erdrick on Midenhall, the Water Flying Cloth on Moonbrooke, and Magic Armor on Cannock, which is almost as good.

evidence.quote: put the Armor of Erdrick on Midenhall, Water Flying Cloth on Moonbrooke and...Magic Armor on Cannock, almost as good.

subject: Dragon Horn Towers
text: Equip the Cloak of Wind and jump from the tower facing the direction you intend to fall to cross between the Dragon Horn Towers.

evidence.quote: Make sure you have you the cloak of wind equipped.  2. Make sure you jump...from the tower facing the direction you intend to fall.  If you leave the west...end of a tower you will fall west.

subject: Dragon Horn Towers
text: Leaving the west end of a Dragon Horn Tower makes you fall west.

evidence.quote: If you leave the west...end of a tower you will fall west.

subject: Watergate key holder
text: The prisoner with the watergate key did not escape; he dug a secret room against the right wall of his cell and is still inside.

evidence.quote: He hasn't actually escaped from his cell, he dug a little secret room against...the right wall, he's still in there.

subject: Gold from monsters
text: Collecting gold from monsters is slow, and leveling up while doing so is also slow.

evidence.quote: Yup... It does.  So does leveling up while collecting that gold.

subject: Falcon Sword
text: Falcon Sword gives two attacks, but its attack power is weak.

evidence.quote: the falcon sword gives two attacks, the power is still really...crappy.

subject: Falcon Sword
text: Falcon Sword does far more damage than the Copper Sword at level six despite its weak attack power.

evidence.quote: True, but weapon attack power is not the entire factor for deciding damage,...far greater than you did at level six with your copper sword.

subject: Crests
text: All the crests may already be in the inventory when the game starts, which the guide says happens from time to time and saves time.

evidence.quote: 6) For some strange reason all the crests were in my inventory when the game started, why?...It happens from time to time.  I have no idea why, but it is quite a time

subject: Sacrifice spell
text: The guide knows no way to prevent death when Sacrifice is cast on you, and calls it really annoying.

evidence.quote: 9) Is there anyway to prevent death when sacrifice is cast on you?...Not that I know of, it is REALLY annoying, I'll say that much.
